subject: URGENT: VegaHealth production anomalies after model v2.1q rollout
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@vegahealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Theo Martinez <theo.martinez@vegahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:33 -0700
Subject: Spike in latency + hallucinations after v2.1q rollout

Hi Lauren,

We rolled the new model build (v2.1q, q8_approx profile) onto our production route at ~08:50 PT as coordinated with your team. Within 15 minutes we started seeing p95 latency jump from ~220ms to ~1.6s and a sharp increase in malformed outputs / hallucinations in our clinical note generation pipeline. Error-rate (500s) rose from 0.3% to ~4%.

Attached are a short trace bundle and a p95 delta PDF. The bulk of affected requests are on patient-summary route /v1/generate with typical sequences (~450 tokens). We have throttled traffic to degrade gracefully but this is customer-visible.

Can your on-call look immediately? We need a mitigation plan and ETA to restore previous behavior. This is a high-severity production incident for VegaHealth (their Ops+Comms are standing by).

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Operations | VegaHealth

Attachments: vega_20260809_traces.zip, p95_latency_report_0809.pdf
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@vegahealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:22:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + hallucinations after v2.1q rollout

Hi Samira — I’m escalating this to our SRE and model teams immediately. Thank you for the traces.

Immediate next steps from our side (will confirm by 09:40 PT):
- Marcus (SRE) to validate kernel selection & quant path on the serving hosts you hit and share hot traces.
- Rishi (model infra) to check kv-cache behavior and any non-determinism introduced by q8_approx profile.
- If we confirm a regression tied to v2.1q, we will propose a fast rollback (canary -> full) and a short credit / SLA remediation.

We treat this as a Sev-1. I’ll keep you posted every 15–30 mins until stable.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0128
From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:31:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + hallucinations after v2.1q rollout

Lauren / Rishi — quick notes from initial triage:
- Confirmed elevated p95 on machines in us-west-2 pool (hosts: rw-usw2-rtg-03..06).
- Kernel selection shows fallback to reference attention kernel for sequences >384 when q8_approx is active — that path is ~6–8x slower in our benchmark for this model family.
- Also seeing increased decode retries (internal error 1021) when token logits are near-clipped ranges — likely due to quantization perturbation.

I’ve uploaded condensed traces to the incident bundle and attached a canary rollback plan (canary-rollback-plan.md). For immediate mitigation:
1) Re-route VegaHealth traffic to v2.0-stable variant (non-quantized) via a route override (can be done in 6–8 mins).
2) Disable the q8_approx profile at the model-agent level for VegaHealth customer id.

I recommend (1) as fastest path to restore latency/quality while we root-cause quant perturbation.

Marcus Lin
SRE, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: canary-rollback-plan.md
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 10:05:17 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in latency + hallucinations after v2.1q rollout

Adding a few model-side observations:
- v2.1 upstream changes included a new attention-splitting optimization that interacts poorly with q8_approx for longer contexts (>400 tokens). We saw small non-deterministic logits shifts in bench tests but not at production scale; looks like the combination pushes some samples across decision thresholds.
- We’ll reproduce locally with a VegaHealth prompt corpus (request Samira’s redacted prompt set).

Operational asks for rollback:
- Need a direct OK from account team (Monica) to flip route override.
- Recommend we offer VegaHealth a 2-week credit and a post-mortem within 72 hours.

I’ll run reproduce tests and post a short technical summary by 12:00 PT.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal, Model Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Spike in latency + hallucinations after v2.1q rollout

1) One-page incident summary (what changed, impact, mitigation timeline) by noon PT. I want to be ready with a customer statement and a proposed credit.
2) Please list if any customers (beyond VegaHealth) were hit by the same canary; if so, we may need broader communications.
3) Keep the proposed rollback ready but do not execute without Monica’s confirmation to VegaHealth.

If VegaHealth escalates to legal/sales, I’ll coordinate externally.

—Aditya Rao
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
